method: All nodes classified on each CAD surface, plus four Tri6 interior reference points on up to the declared number of deterministically selected triangles per CAD face; Euclidean distance to Gmsh getClosestPoint on owning surface.
tolerance_basis: Additional project candidate-screening tolerances, not industry standards: collar .003mm (10% of nominal .03mm onset excess), adhesive .0075mm (5% of nominal .15mm bondline), other surfaces .015mm. This sampled interior test is not a rigorous global geometry error bound.
